name: bbaktaeho-agent-skills
description: Agent skills for Go development, Elasticsearch, Postgres best practices, programming principles, AI agent instruction setup, and blockchain research (Ethereum, Solana, Tempo)

plugins.name: golang-best-practices
plugins.description: Idiomatic Go patterns, best practices, and conventions for building robust, efficient, and maintainable Go applications. Use when writing, reviewing, or optimizing Go code, designing packages, writing tests, or benchmarking performance.

plugins.name: elasticsearch-best-practices
plugins.description: Elasticsearch best practices covering mapping, query DSL, index settings, bulk indexing, analyzers, shard sizing, aggregations, pagination, ILM, aliases, and cluster monitoring. Use when designing or changing index mappings, writing or tuning search queries, configuring analyzers, planning shards, building bulk indexing pipelines, or diagnosing Elasticsearch performance issues.

plugins.name: postgres-best-practices
plugins.description: Postgres performance optimization and best practices. Use when writing, reviewing, or optimizing Postgres queries, schema designs, or database configurations.

plugins.name: agent-instructions-setup
plugins.description: Initialize AI coding agent instruction files. Creates AGENTS.md as the single source of truth, 7 symlinks covering 9 AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Gemini CLI, Codex, Zed, Antigravity), and scaffolds docs/guide.md and docs/workflow.md. Use when initializing a new project for AI-assisted development or unifying existing instruction files.

plugins.name: programming-principles
plugins.description: Programming principles and philosophy based on Rob Pike's 5 Rules of Programming. Use when making optimization decisions, choosing between simple and complex algorithms, designing data structures, evaluating performance tuning approaches, reviewing code for unnecessary complexity, or pushing back on premature optimization and over-engineering.

plugins.name: blockchain-research
plugins.description: Multi-chain blockchain protocol and on-chain data indexing research skill. Use when investigating Ethereum (EVM, EIPs, go-ethereum, reth, revm, prysm), Solana (SVM, SIMDs, PoH, agave, SPL), or Tempo (TIP-20, MPP, Simplex BFT, Payment Lanes, Fee AMM); or when researching indexing concerns (reorg, finality, ABI/IDL, asset standards, RPC, protocol-level transfers, tx envelopes, state access).
